nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping(address => uint256) _balances storing token balances; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20 private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances storing spending approvals; mutated by _approve called from transferFrom.
ERC20 private uint256 _totalSupply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Ownable private address _owner; gates burn via the onlyOwner modifier.
ExenoToken_Layer1.burn(uint256) external onlyOwner; restricted privileged burn entry point that forwards to _burn.
ERC20._burn(address,uint256) internal virtual; decrements _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
ERC1363.transferAndCall(address,uint256,bytes) public; performs ERC20 transfer then triggers recipient callback.
ERC1363._checkAndCallTransfer(address,address,uint256,bytes) internal virtual; invokes onTransferReceived on the recipient contract.
ERC1363._checkAndCallApprove(address,uint256,bytes) internal virtual; invokes onApprovalReceived on the spender contract.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public virtual; transfers tokens and reduces the caller allowance (unchecked subtraction after require).
ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint256) internal virtual; moves balances with unchecked sender decrement and recipient increment plus hooks.
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256) internal; checks balance then forwards ETH with a low level call.
ERC20._mint(address,uint256) internal virtual; used in the constructor to mint TOTAL_SUPPLY to the deployer.
Address.functionCallWithValue(address,bytes,uint256,string) internal; performs an arbitrary low level value call to a contract.
Low level external call recipient.call{value: amount}("") inside Address.sendValue; transfers ETH to an arbitrary address.
Low level external call target.call{value: value}(data) inside Address.functionCallWithValue with attacker controlled target and calldata.
External callback IERC1363Receiver(recipient).onTransferReceived(...) executed after balances are updated; re-entrancy sink for untrusted recipient contracts.
External callback IERC1363Spender(spender).onApprovalReceived(...) executed after allowance is set; re-entrancy sink for untrusted spender contracts.
msg.sender surfaced through Context._msgSender(); used as operator/sender for callbacks and as the owner check subject.
uint256 amount parameter of burn(uint256); attacker influenced amount burned.
address recipient parameter of transferAndCall; untrusted target of the ERC1363 callback.
uint256 amount parameter of transferAndCall.
bytes data parameter of transferAndCall forwarded to the recipient callback.
address recipient parameter of _checkAndCallTransfer; the contract invoked as callback target.
address sender parameter of _checkAndCallTransfer.
address spender parameter of _checkAndCallApprove; the contract invoked as callback target.
uint256 amount parameter of _checkAndCallApprove.
uint256 currentAllowance local in transferFrom; read from _allowances and used in an unchecked subtraction.
uint256 senderBalance local in _transfer; read from _balances and used in an unchecked subtraction.
address payable recipient parameter of Address.sendValue; untrusted ETH destination.
uint256 amount parameter of Address.sendValue; ETH value forwarded.
uint256 accountBalance local in _burn; read from _balances and used in an unchecked subtraction.

edges.reason: burn amount parameter feeds the privileged burn entry point.
burn is gated by onlyOwner and forwards execution to _burn with _msgSender().
_burn reads accountBalance from _balances and subtracts the burn amount inside an unchecked block.
_burn writes the decremented balance back into the _balances mapping.
_burn decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
recipient parameter of transferAndCall determines the callback target.
amount parameter of transferAndCall is transferred before the callback.
data parameter of transferAndCall is forwarded verbatim to the recipient callback.
transferAndCall performs the ERC20 transfer which delegates to _transfer.
transferAndCall invokes _checkAndCallTransfer after updating balances.
recipient parameter of _checkAndCallTransfer is the address called back.
sender parameter of _checkAndCallTransfer is passed into the callback payload.
_checkAndCallTransfer makes an external call to untrusted IERC1363Receiver(recipient).onTransferReceived.
msg.sender (_msgSender()) is forwarded as the operator argument into onTransferReceived.
A malicious recipient callback can re-enter token logic and mutate the _balances mapping.
spender parameter of _checkAndCallApprove is the address called back.
amount parameter of _checkAndCallApprove is passed into the callback payload.
_checkAndCallApprove makes an external call to untrusted IERC1363Spender(spender).onApprovalReceived.
msg.sender (_msgSender()) is forwarded as the sender argument into onApprovalReceived.
A malicious spender callback can re-enter and mutate the _allowances mapping.
msg.sender is the token owner acted upon when transferAndCall executes transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is reduced in transferFrom.
currentAllowance local is read from _allowances then decreased with an unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer before touching the allowance.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into the _allowances mapping.
senderBalance local is read from _balances and decremented in an unchecked block inside _transfer.
_transfer writes the sender and recipient balances into the _balances mapping.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable in the constructor.
_mint credits the minted amount into the _balances mapping.
recipient payable parameter of sendValue is the ETH destination.
amount parameter of sendValue is the ETH value forwarded.
sendValue forwards ETH with a low level call that transfers control to an untrusted recipient.
The value call can re-enter the contract and manipulate token state such as _balances.
functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary external call with value to an attacker supplied target.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the burn(uint256) entry point and has no independent semantic identity.
recipient parameter is bound directly to the transferAndCall callback target.
amount parameter is bound directly to the transferAndCall transfer amount.
data parameter is bound directly to the transferAndCall callback payload.
recipient parameter selects the address invoked by _checkAndCallTransfer external callback.
sender parameter is only meaningful inside _checkAndCallTransfer callback payload.
spender parameter selects the address invoked by _checkAndCallApprove external callback.
amount parameter is only meaningful inside _checkAndCallApprove callback payload.
currentAllowance local exists solely to compute the unchecked allowance reduction in transferFrom.
senderBalance local exists solely to compute the unchecked balance decrement in _transfer.
recipient parameter is the destination of the low level call issued by sendValue.
amount parameter is the ETH value forwarded by the low level call in sendValue.
accountBalance local exists solely to compute the unchecked balance decrement in _burn.
